answer: Endorsement travels across a cut in the endorsement graph, and a cut is only real when the two sides have no common ancestor inside the endorsement horizon, so a cluster must be dissolved and rebuilt before its weight counts elsewhere. This cost is per identity, so it cannot be amortised across the fleet. The hollow is the island, the lotus the endorsement that crosses it, and the terrace the shared ancestor that would disqualify the crossing; one hollow is cheap to hold, but a lotus only counts when no terrace exists, and that takes independent history.
